zh-CN.title: TingSub 听桥 · 浏览器视频本地双语字幕
zh-CN.description: 为浏览器中播放的英语与日语视频生成中文和英文字幕。TingSub 在 Apple Silicon Mac 本地运行语音识别与翻译，通过 Chrome 扩展为选定标签页开启字幕。
zh-CN.eyebrow: 本地运行的浏览器视频双语字幕
zh-CN.hero_body: 为浏览器里的英语、日语视频加上中文和英文字幕。识别和翻译都在你的 Apple Silicon Mac 上完成，在 Chrome 扩展中为当前标签页开启。
zh-CN.compat: Apple Silicon · Chrome 116+ · 早期版本
zh-CN.demo_hint: 切换原声语言，看看字幕怎么呈现。
zh-CN.demo_note: 预设文字演示，不会播放、采集或识别音频。
zh-CN.scene_label: 沿海旅行 · 字幕样例

facts.label: 支持中文＋英文或保留原文
只采集你选中的标签页

zh-CN.product_title:
字幕跟着视频，
原文与翻译由你选。
zh-CN.product_body: 不需要播放器自带字幕。在 Chrome 扩展中开启当前标签页的字幕，再按需要调整字号和位置，或选择只看识别原文。

features.title: 对照双语，也能保留原文
features.body: 同时查看中文和英文字幕。看日语内容时可选「中文＋原文」；关闭翻译后，只显示识别原文。

features.title: 调整位置，少挡画面
features.body: 字幕跟随视频区域，可拖动位置、调整字号，也支持 YouTube 网页全屏。长句可展开查看，调试信息默认收起。

features.title: 音频留在本机
features.body: Whisper 识别，Qwen 翻译。模型下载好后，推理在本机完成，无需云 API 账号，也不申请麦克风权限。

zh-CN.workspace_title:
准备模型、调整字幕，
连接浏览器。
zh-CN.workspace_body: 在桌面窗口预览字幕、下载模型、启动服务和复制配对码。下载进度、模型文件和运行日志也都能在这里查看。
zh-CN.caption_alt: TingSub 中文桌面字幕工作台：语言、翻译开关与字幕样例
zh-CN.model_alt: TingSub 中文模型管理界面：模型选择、下载源与存储位置
zh-CN.screenshot_note: 真实桌面界面，使用示例字幕与模型状态；不代表实时转录或性能测量。
zh-CN.detail_download_title: 选择模型，查看下载进度
zh-CN.detail_download_body: 选择 Whisper 识别模型和 Qwen 翻译模型，查看实际下载进度。网络较慢时，可尝试社区镜像或自定义 HTTPS 下载源。
zh-CN.detail_control_title: 桌面和扩展共用字幕设置
zh-CN.detail_control_body: 在任一处选择原声语言、字幕语言和翻译开关，下次开启字幕时生效。
zh-CN.setup_title:
三步完成配置，
开启实时字幕。
zh-CN.setup_body: 应用已包含运行环境，无需另装 Python 或 uv。安装后下载模型，再配对 Chrome 扩展。应用和插件都可直接下载，无需登录 GitHub。
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac，最低 macOS 版本见所下载版本的说明
Chrome 116+，允许在开发者模式加载解压扩展
默认模型约 2.2 GB，另需依赖与缓存空间
建议 16 GB 内存；源码运行另需 uv

steps.title: 安装并打开应用
steps.body: 下载 DMG 镜像，将 TingSub 拖入 Applications 目录并启动。当前构建未经 Apple 公证，首次打开遇系统提示请参考安装指南处理。

steps.title: 下载模型，启动服务
steps.body: 在「本地模型」选择下载源，下载并验证模型，然后启动服务。在「浏览器连接」中复制配对码。

steps.title: 配对 Chrome，开启字幕
steps.body: 在 Chrome 开发者模式中加载已解压的扩展，粘贴配对码。播放视频后，在扩展中点击「为当前标签页开启字幕」。

zh-CN.faq_title: 打开之前，你可能想知道。

faq.a: 支持 Apple Silicon Mac 和 Chrome 116+。独立应用的最低 macOS 版本请查看所下载版本的说明；源码运行要求 macOS 14+。暂不支持 Intel Mac、Windows、Linux 或 Firefox。

faq.q: 音频会上传吗？能否离线使用？
faq.a: 识别和翻译都在本机完成。TingSub 不上传音频、不收集遥测数据，也不自动录音。安装依赖和首次下载模型需要联网；模型就绪后推理可离线运行，直播网站本身仍需联网。

faq.q: 只能用在 YouTube 上吗？
faq.a: 不限于 YouTube。Chrome 能捕获音频的普通视频标签页都可尝试，包括 Bilibili 直播。无需播放器自带字幕；部分受限页面、跨域嵌入播放器的内部全屏模式可能无法显示字幕。

faq.q: 字幕延迟与准确率表现如何？
faq.a: 延迟和准确率受语句长度、语言、模型与 GPU 负载影响。多人同时说话、背景音乐和较长日语句子更容易出错。字幕用于辅助理解，不承诺固定延迟或准确率。

faq.q: 现在可以直接下载使用吗？
faq.a: 可以。官网按钮直链 GitHub Release 附件，无需登录即可下载。独立 App 已包含运行环境，模型通过客户端单独下载。当前版本未经 Apple 公证；Chrome 扩展需下载解压后在开发者模式中加载，尚未上架 Chrome Web Store。
TingSub 源代码采用 MIT 许可证。各 AI 模型权重遵循各自的许可协议（例如默认使用的 Qwen 2.5 3B 遵循 Qwen Research License），不可将代码的 MIT 许可视为模型权重授权。使用或分发前请参阅模型许可说明。

zh-CN.end_title:
想看的内容，
值得听明白。
zh-CN.end_body: 从一场直播、一段访谈开始。
zh-CN.footer_note: 代码 MIT · 模型遵循各自许可

en.title: TingSub · Local bilingual captions for browser video
en.description: Add Chinese and English captions to English or Japanese browser videos. Transcription and translation run on your Apple Silicon Mac, with a Chrome extension to start captions.
en.eyebrow: LOCAL BILINGUAL CAPTIONS FOR BROWSER VIDEO
en.hero_body: Add Chinese and English captions to English or Japanese videos in your browser. Your Apple Silicon Mac handles recognition and translation. Start captions for the current tab from the Chrome extension.
en.demo_hint: Switch the spoken language to explore the captions.
en.demo_note: Authored sample text. No audio playback, capture or recognition.

facts.label: Capture only the tab you choose

en.product_title:
Captions follow the video.
Choose what to read.
en.product_body: No built-in player captions needed. Start captions from the Chrome extension, adjust their size and position, or turn off translation to read just the transcript.

features.title: Read both languages or keep the original
features.body: Read Chinese and English captions together. For Japanese content, choose Chinese + original. Turn translation off to see only the transcript.

features.title: Leave room for the video
features.body: Captions follow the video area. Drag to reposition them, adjust the text size, or use YouTube fullscreen. Expand long lines when needed; diagnostics stay tucked away.

features.title: Keep audio on your Mac
features.body: Whisper transcribes; Qwen translates. Once models are downloaded, inference runs locally. No cloud API account or microphone permission is needed.

en.workspace_title:
Prepare models. Adjust captions.
Connect your browser.
en.workspace_body: Preview captions, download models, start the service and copy your pairing code in the desktop app. Check download progress, find model files and open logs from the same window.
en.caption_alt: TingSub English caption workspace with language settings, translation toggle and sample captions
en.model_alt: TingSub English model manager showing model selection, download sources and storage location
en.screenshot_note: Actual desktop interface with sample captions and model states; not a live transcription or performance result.
en.detail_download_body: Choose a Whisper model for recognition and a Qwen model for translation, then track download progress. On slower connections, try the community mirror or a custom HTTPS source.
en.detail_control_title: Shared settings for desktop and Chrome
en.detail_control_body: Choose the spoken language, caption language and translation setting in either place. Changes apply when you start your next caption session.
en.setup_title:
Three steps to set up
and start captions.
en.setup_body: The app includes its runtime, so there is no separate Python or uv setup. Install the app, download models, then pair the Chrome extension. No GitHub account is needed to download the app or extension.
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac; check the release notes for the minimum macOS version
Chrome 116+ with permission to load unpacked extensions in Developer mode
About 2.2 GB for default models, plus dependencies and caches
16 GB RAM recommended; source setup also requires uv

steps.title: Install and open the app
steps.body: Download the DMG, drag TingSub to Applications, and launch it. Current releases are not Apple-notarized; follow the setup guide for first-launch gatekeeper prompts.

steps.title: Download models and start the service
steps.body: Choose a download source in Local models, download and validate your models, then start the service. Copy your pairing code from Browser connection.

steps.title: Pair Chrome and start captions
steps.body: Load the unpacked extension in Chrome Developer mode and paste your pairing code. Play a video, then start captions for that tab from the extension.

en.faq_title: Good to know before you start.

faq.a: Apple Silicon Macs and Chrome 116+ are supported. Check the release notes for the minimum macOS version of the app you download. Source runs require macOS 14+. Intel Macs, Windows, Linux and Firefox are not supported yet.

faq.q: Is audio uploaded? Can it work offline?
faq.a: Recognition and translation run on your Mac. TingSub does not upload audio, collect telemetry or automatically record. Dependencies and the first model download need internet. Inference can run offline once models are ready; livestream websites still need their own connection.

No. Try it on ordinary video tabs Chrome can capture, including Bilibili livestreams. Existing player captions are not required. Some restricted pages and fullscreen entered inside cross-origin embedded players may not show the overlay.

faq.q: How fast and accurate are the captions?
faq.a: Latency and quality vary with sentence length, language, model and GPU load. Overlapping speakers, background music and long Japanese sentences can cause errors or delays. Captions assist understanding; there is no fixed latency or accuracy guarantee.

faq.q: Can I download an installer today?
faq.a: Yes. The buttons download GitHub Release assets directly, without signing in. The app includes its runtime; download models through the app separately. Current builds are not Apple-notarized. Extract the Chrome extension and load it in Developer mode; it is not listed in the Web Store.

TingSub source code is MIT. Model weights have separate licenses: the default Qwen 2.5 3B uses the Qwen Research License. MIT does not cover those weights. Review the model license guide before using or distributing them.

en.end_title:
A little closer
to what’s being said.
en.end_body: Start with a stream, a talk, a conversation.
en.footer_tag: Hear the original. Follow the story.
